terms.definition: A small window that shows a short message and waits for the answer.

video.title: Alert, Confirmation Dialog & Popover | Day 144
video.description:
Learn to explain how to ask the user a question in SwiftUI: Alert, Confirmation Dialog & Popover, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Alert - A small window that shows a short message and waits for the answer.
Confirmation Dialog - A list of choices that slides up from the bottom to confirm an action.
Popover - A small floating panel that points to the view that opened it.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: SwiftUI Alert, Confirmation Dialog & Popover | Day 144
landscape.description:
Explain Alert, Confirmation Dialog & Popover in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
얼럿, 컨펌메이션 다이얼로그, 팝오버 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Alert - A small window that shows a short message and waits for the answer.
한국어: 얼럿: 짧은 메시지를 보여 주고 사용자의 답을 기다리는 작은 창

Confirmation Dialog - A list of choices that slides up from the bottom to confirm an action.
한국어: 컨펌메이션 다이얼로그: 동작을 확인하기 위해 아래에서 올라오는 선택지 목록

Popover - A small floating panel that points to the view that opened it.
한국어: 팝오버: 자신을 연 뷰를 가리키며 떠 있는 작은 패널

In this video, Mina and Jake ask before a note is deleted, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.

landscape.hook: Can you explain Alert, Confirmation Dialog and Popover in English?

dialogue.title: Are you sure?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the user taps Delete, and the note is gone at once.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Ask first. Show an Alert with a short message, like `Sure?` in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: An Alert is a small window in the middle, right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. It is good for a message that needs one answer.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if I want Delete, Archive and Cancel?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use a Confirmation Dialog. It shows a list of choices that slides up from the bottom.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I put five choices into an Alert, and it looked crowded.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, move them to a Confirmation Dialog. An Alert should stay short.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: On iPad, the Confirmation Dialog looks like a bubble.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is a Popover. It is a small floating panel that points to its button.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can I use a Popover on iPhone?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You can, but a Popover is most useful on iPad, because there is more space.
Show an Alert before you delete the note.
